D/ CONSTANTINVS IVN NOB C ; R/ PROVIDEN TIAE CAESS

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantine II as Caesar (317-337), dating to AD 324-5 (Reece Period 16), PROVIDENTIAE CAESS, Camp gate with two turrets and star above. Mint of Trier. RIC vol. VII, p. 205, no. 455. Obverse description: Bust laureate draped and cuirassed left. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTINVS IVN NOB C. Reverse description: Camp gate, two towers, star above, six courses masonry, open door. Reverse inscription: PROVIDEN TIAE CAESS. In exergue: STR. Diameter: 18.3mm, Weight: 2.72gms, die axis: 6
